headline: Triumph Street Triple 798 RS Costs ₹14.39 Lakh in India
tag_evidence: No tag. Triumph India's site (triumphmotorcycles.in) links Facebook, X, YouTube and WhatsApp but no Instagram account. Triumph's UK site links instagram.com/triumphuk, which is the UK market account, not an Indian one, so I left it out.

image.licence: Official Triumph Motorcycles product/press image from the maker's own Street Triple 798 RS page (Triumph media CDN), credited 'Image: Triumph Motorcycles'
image.author: Triumph Motorcycles
image.subject: Triumph Street Triple 798 RS (MY27), black with yellow '798' tank graphic, side profile, parked on a racetrack at sunset, no rider

fact_sources.fact: Street Triple 798 RS India price ₹14.39 lakh (ex-showroom per Autocar India; Triumph India lists 'From ₹14,39,000')
Street Triple 765 RS listed at ₹13.19 lakh; 798 RS costs ₹1.2 lakh more
No India delivery date announced (Triumph India page gives no date; Autocar India says it could be some time before it arrives in India)
New 798cc three-cylinder replaces the 765cc engine; 135 PS at 11,500 rpm; 86 Nm at 9,250 rpm; 183 kg wet
7-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto (Triumph UK page: 'wireless Apple CarPlay® for your iPhone and Android Auto™ ... connect wirelessly')
